subject: Request: merge exception artifacts + CI controls for SIG intake
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@meridianbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: MeridianBank Risk Team <risk-assessors@meridianbank.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Merge exception observed during SIG intake - request for artifacts

Hi Jonas,

During our SIG intake review we noted a recent production merge (PR #4957) that was marked as an exception to the standard branch protection rules. To close the control gap for our report we need the following artifacts from Redwood: 1) the merge exception request and approval timeline, 2) PR review history (screenshots or evidence of approvals), 3) CI/CD pipeline run logs for the deployment in question, and 4) a short statement on compensating controls (why the exception was granted and how risk was mitigated).

Can you provide those items (redactions OK for internal IP) by EOD Friday? Our assessor is preparing the SOC/SIG package and this will be appended to the deviation log.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Senior Security Assessor
MeridianBank Risk Team

--
Attachment placeholders: merge-exception-log-20260527.csv (csv), request-email-thread.eml (eml)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@meridianbank.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Merge exception observed during SIG intake - request for artifacts

Team — forwarding Meridian's intake note. They flagged the PR we shipped last week as an exception; request is for merge justification + PR review + CI logs + short compensating-controls statement.

Quick asks:
- Lauren: can you pull the approval timeline and the decision note from the change board?
- Jordan: please export the CI/CD run logs and a sanitized pipeline trace for the deploy job.
- Irene: can you draft a 3–4 line compensating-controls blurb (code review coverage, rollback plan, and monitoring alerts used)?

Deadline: they asked EOD Friday (2026-05-28). If we can't meet that, propose a 48-hour extension and provide what we have.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, irene_choi@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@meridianbank.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Merge exception observed during SIG intake - request for artifacts

Hi all —

I've pulled the change-board record and the approval email thread. Summary:
- PR 4957 was opened 2026-05-20 to address an urgent data-path bug that caused partial indexing failures.
- A temporary bypass of branch protection was approved by the on-call release manager (Avery Johnson) and the infra lead (Jordan Blake) to allow a hotfix merge after 2 reviewer signoffs could not be obtained in time.
- The exception request and approval were logged in the change register (entry id CHG-20260520-78).

Attachments included:
- change-register-CHG-20260520-78.pdf (redacted)
- approval-email-chain.eml (redacted)
- pr-4957-review-screenshots.zip (screenshots showing reviewer approvals and CI status badges)

I'm attaching a CSV export of the merge-exception log and a snapshot of the change-register. Due to GDPR fields in some comments I've redacted contributor emails in the PDF.

If Meridian needs original raw emails I can work with Legal to provide a limited export.

Lauren Bishop
Engineering Manager, Release Ops
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: change-register-CHG-20260520-78.pdf, approval-email-chain.eml, pr-4957-review-screenshots.zip

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@meridianbank.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Merge exception observed during SIG intake - request for artifacts

Adding the CI artifacts per Lauren's summary. Items provided below and attached to this thread:

1) ci-runbook-snapshot-20260527.pdf — excerpt of the pipeline runbook describing approval gates, automated smoke tests, and rollback policy.
2) pipeline-trace-pr4957.txt — sanitized timeline (timestamps, step names, anonymized worker IDs).
3) deploy-job-logs-20260521.tar.gz — gzipped log bundle for the production deploy.

Notes: the deploy job failed one downstream integration test on a canary node; automatic rollback did not trigger because the failure was classified as non-deterministic by the pipeline heuristics. The release manager manually rolled forward after observing application-level metrics and running a targeted fix (this is in the change-register PDF).

Let me know if you need the raw logs; I can generate an HSM-signed S3 export but that will take 1–2 business days for redaction and access approvals.

Jordan Blake
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: ci-runbook-snapshot-20260527.pdf, pipeline-trace-pr4957.txt, deploy-job-logs-20260521.tar.gz

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@meridianbank.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Merge exception observed during SIG intake - request for artifacts

Sam / Meridian team —

Short compensating-controls statement (approved for disclosure):
Redwood granted a one-time branch-protection exception for PR #4957 due to an operational severity-level 2 incident that required an expedited fix. The exception was approved by the on-call release manager and infra lead, recorded in the change register, and accompanied by elevated post-deploy monitoring:
- Additional synthetic checks and elevated application and infra alerts for 72 hours post-deploy.
- Immediate smoke tests and a manual rollback playbook available to the release manager.
- Post-incident root-cause analysis and follow-up remediation (tracking ticket INFRA-4957-RCA).

We consider this a documented, auditable exception with compensating controls to reduce residual risk. If you want a short paragraph on how we map that to SOC2 control objectives I can expand.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Head of Trust & Security Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@meridianbank.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-29T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Merge exception observed during SIG intake - request for artifacts

Jonas / Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts. We received: change-register PDF, approval email chain, PR screenshots, CI runbook excerpt, pipeline trace, and deploy logs. This is sufficient for the deviation appendix for now.

Two quick follow-ups before we close the item: 1) please include the CHG-20260520-78 change-register index number in the PDF metadata (we saw the line in the document but need it in the metadata field for ingestion), and 2) can you confirm whether the post-deploy synthetic checks were created as new alerts (yes/no) or simply elevation of existing thresholds?

If you can reply with those two small clarifications within 48 hours we can mark this deviation as closed in our SIG intake.

Best,
Sam Patel
Senior Security Assessor
MeridianBank Risk Team

--
